faq: Do you need tracking in place already?
Yes, source information has to exist in your leads. If it does not, our lead tracking service sets it up first, and then this report becomes far more useful.
What data do you need from me?
An export of your leads with dates and, if you have them, source and outcome. A CRM export or a spreadsheet works. We handle your data privately and delete our copy after delivery if you ask.
Can the report include my ad spend?
Yes. Give us spend per channel for the period, or view access to your ad accounts, and we calculate cost per lead and per won lead.
Will you tell me to stop a source?
Only when the numbers support it. We explain the evidence and the size of the sample, and we say plainly when there is too little data to decide.

desc:
A lead source report shows which channels bring leads worth your time, and which only fill your inbox. Ecom Swift LLC analyzes your own lead data and, where you can share outcomes and spend, compares search, ads, social media, referrals and email in plain words.

## What is a lead source report?

A lead source report groups your enquiries by where they came from and then compares the groups. It counts leads, but it goes further: how many replied, how many booked, how many became customers and what each source cost you. The comparison is written as a short verdict for each channel.

It uses only your own data, so every figure in it can be traced back to a real enquiry.

## Why more leads are not always better

A channel that sends a large number of enquiries may still be a poor use of your time. If most of those people never reply or cannot afford the work, the count flatters the source. Meanwhile a smaller channel, such as referrals or an email list, may send fewer people who turn into customers.

Judging only by volume leads you to feed the wrong channels. Looking at outcomes and cost shows which sources deserve more effort and which deserve less.

## How a report improves your results

A clear report lets you move budget and time with confidence. You can reduce spending on a channel that costs a lot per customer and put it into one that produces customers at a lower cost. You can also spot a quiet channel that performs well and give it attention.

It helps with timing too. Looking across several months shows trends, such as a campaign that faded or a referral source that grew. A report cannot predict the future, and results depend on the quality of your data, but it replaces guesswork with a documented basis for decisions.

## What a great source report includes

- A count of leads by source for the chosen period.
- Reply and booking rates for each source.
- Won, lost and open leads, where outcomes are available.
- Cost per lead, and cost per won lead, where spend is known.
- A month-by-month trend.
- The best campaigns, pages or posts inside each source.
- A fair note on gaps or unreliable data.
- A quality view that combines volume, fit and outcome.
- A plain verdict on each channel: invest, hold or reconsider.
- A list of next steps.

## What we do

We start by gathering your lead list from a CRM, sheet, form tool or inbox, and your spend figures if you wish to include them. We clean the data, group each lead by source and fill in outcomes where you can supply them. Where the source is missing, we say so and explain how it affects the result.

Then we compare channels and write the report in everyday language. Larger packages cover more months, add won and lost outcomes, calculate the cost per won lead and show the best campaigns inside each source. The largest package also includes a budget and time shift plan and a review call after delivery. If your tracking is incomplete, we point out what to fix so the next report is stronger.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Share outcomes, not only names and dates.
- Include the money you spent on each channel.
- Compare channels over the same period.
- Act on the clearest finding first.
- Order a fresh report after a few months of changes.

**Avoid:**
- Judging a channel on a single month.
- Counting every enquiry as equally valuable.
- Cutting a source before checking whether it feeds other channels.
- Ignoring leads with an unknown source.
- Treating the report as final rather than as a guide.

## Who this service is for

This service suits a business that spends on several channels and cannot tell which one pays off. It also suits an owner who feels busy but is unsure whether the leads are turning into work. Someone planning next quarter's marketing plan will find the report a useful starting point.

## What we need from you

Send an export of your leads with dates and sources, outcomes if you have them, and your spend by channel. Customer names can be removed. We never ask for passwords. If access is easier, give us view access as a collaborator or staff user in your CRM or analytics tool.
